summary: Retested BATCH N1 (Advocate Consultation Notetaker) backend + frontend after fixes from prior session: ran the full backend suite directly (52/52 passing), and manually walked the full frontend flow (login as verified advocate -> create matter -> create consultation -> decline a required participant -> blocked notice + manual-only button -> re-consent given -> READY -> manual notes -> AI draft generation (Claude) -> 'Facts stated by participants' rendered with real content -> edit item -> save -> approve (native confirm dialog) -> ApprovedStep also shows facts -> copy/export -> create task drafts -> tasks.tsx and matters list regression). All flows worked exactly as specified in the review request.

issues: No testID attributes on any interactive element in the Notetaker module (buttons, text inputs). Current tests had to rely on placeholder text / get_by_text selectors, which is more brittle than testID. Login screen and other parts of the app DO use data-testid (e.g. login-email-input), so this module is inconsistent with the rest of the codebase's testing conventions. Not a functional bug, but should be added for long-term test stability.

action_items: Optional (non-blocking): add testID props to Notetaker screens/buttons (ConsentStep, NoteDraftStep, ApprovedStep, new.tsx form fields) for more robust automated testing going forward.

Confirmed working as designed - no action needed: approve/consent-continue-manual-only confirmations use crossAlert which falls back to native window.confirm()/alert() on web; this is expected RN-Web behavior, not a bug.
critical_code_review_comments: api.ts, ConsentStep.tsx, NoteDraftStep.tsx, ApprovedStep.tsx all consistently use 'facts_stated' (matching backend) - the previously reported rename bug is verified fixed.
Idempotency-Key header is correctly wired via newIdempotencyKey() on consent submit, continue-manual-only, and task-draft creation calls in ConsentStep.tsx and ApprovedStep.tsx.

advocateVerified prop correctly gates Generate/Regenerate/Approve buttons in NoteDraftStep and Copy/Export buttons in ApprovedStep with explanatory amber notices; defaults to false (most restrictive) until the profile fetch resolves, which is the safe default.

[id].tsx confirmed has no case for a CONSULTATION_WITHDRAWN terminal state (renders blank body) - this is the pre-existing, explicitly out-of-scope gap for BATCH N5 per the agent-to-agent context note; not flagged as a new regression.

Frontend consent UI flow has an inherent ordering constraint worth noting for QA/documentation: once a consultation reaches READY (even with just one participant's consent), the UI switches to InputStep and there is no further UI entry point to add/decline additional participants from that screen (ConsentStep is only rendered for DRAFT/CONSENT_PENDING per the [id].tsx switch-case). To exercise the 'decline on a second required participant demotes back to CONSENT_PENDING' scenario from the UI, the decline must be recorded BEFORE any consent reaches READY (e.g. decline participant B first, then give participant A) - which is what was used successfully in this test run. This is not a bug (the backend itself supports consent recording in any state and demotes correctly - confirmed by backend test), but if the product intends advocates to add a 'declined' participant's consent again after READY from the UI, there is currently no entry point for that from InputStep onward.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_QA_N1_Full..Full4 matters + consultations via UI during this test run (and backend test suite creates its own TEST_ prefixed matters/consultations/tasks/users on every run). Left in place per test data rules (no bulk delete available in UI; these are clearly TEST_ prefixed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: BATCH N1 is fully verified working on both backend (52/52 pytest) and frontend (manual Playwright walkthrough of the complete happy path + the decline/block/recover consent UX + facts_stated rendering + verification gating UI). Do NOT proceed to N2-N8 scope without an explicit 'GO N[x]' from the user, per the strict rule stated in the problem statement. The one real finding from this session is purely cosmetic/testability (missing testID attributes in the Notetaker module) and the UI ordering nuance documented above - neither blocks sign-off on N1.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found in this retest round; all previously-reported issues (8 failing tests, facts_stated rename, ConsentStep dead-end) were confirmed fixed by direct reproduction.
